payload.title: Prefer external microphone sources in automatic podcast multicam and repair affected episode
payload.description: Investigate camera audio incorrectly retained despite supplied WAV microphones. Fix canonical source selection and add regression coverage; repair the current episode if microphone alignment can be established without changing cuts.
acceptance: External microphone audio is chosen over camera audio when supplied; ambiguity cannot silently choose camera audio.
Regression tests cover automatic podcast source selection and applied audio finishing.
Inspect affected live episode and repair audio preserving cuts and sync if feasible; otherwise state concrete blocker.
